on_screen_text.text: As we speak this evening, it's been just one month
since the United States military began Operation Epic Fury,
targeting the world's number one state sponsor of terror, Iran.
We are in this military operation,
so powerful, so brilliant,
against one of the most powerful countries for 32 days,
and the country has been eviscerated
and essentially is really no longer a threat.
They were the bully of the Middle East,
but they're the bully no longer.
This is a true investment in your children and your grandchildren's future.
The whole world is watching,
and they can't believe the power,
strength and brilliance. I just can't believe what they're seeing.
They leave it to your imagination,
but they can't believe what they're seeing.
The brilliance of the United States military tonight.
Every American can look forward to a day
when we are finally free from the wickedness of Iranian aggression
and the spectre of nuclear blackmail.
Because of the actions we have taken,
we are on the cusp of ending Iran's
sinister threat to America and the world.
And I'll tell you, the world is watching.
And when we do, when it's all over,
the United States will be safer,
stronger, more prosperous and greater than it has ever been before.

spoken_summary: Donald Trump announces that a military operation called "Operation Epic Fury" was launched against Iran one month ago. He claims that after 32 days, Iran has been "eviscerated" and is "no longer a threat." He praises the power and brilliance of the U.S. military, stating the world is watching in disbelief. Trump frames this action as an investment in the future, promising that it will free America from Iranian aggression and nuclear blackmail, ultimately making the United States safer and greater.
